docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A selection of the Jātaka stories of the Buddha’s former births, chosen from Cowell’s translation and arranged by theme, with the editors’ introduction (Cambridge, 1916). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the New York Public Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Jataka tales · Francis, H. T. (Henry Thomas), 1837-1924, Thomas, E. J. (Edward Joseph), 1869- · 1916, 536 scanned pages. Published 1916; Henry Thomas Francis died 1924 and Edward Joseph Thomas 1958; the stories are ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
